description: Lists the trainer's classes and appointments between two dates (today and the next 7 days by default): date and time, student, phone to confirm, type, status, place, notes, video link of the online ones and the app_url to open each appointment in the app. Times are in Brazil time (America/Sao_Paulo). Pass status=no_show with a past window (from/to) to answer "who missed class?": only those, so the trainer can call the student (student_phone) or open the appointment in the app; no_show/completed or a window entirely in the past are listed most recent first. Read only.

status.description: Only appointments with this status: pending_confirmation, scheduled, confirmed, cancelled, completed or no_show (missed).

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 7 days after "from". At most 62 days after "from".

name: get_schedule
title: See my schedule
